title: Ravana's palace
introduction: Hanuma sees the denizens of city of Lanka rendered beautiful by the glorious moon, Hanuma also become anxious had not become to able to find Seetha.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये सुन्दर काण्डे पञ्चमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 5th chapter in Sundara Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ततः स मध्यंगतमंशुमन्तं |
ज्योत्स्नावितानम् महदुद्वमन्तम् |
ददर्श धीमान् दिवि भानुमन्तम् |
गोष्ठे वृषं मत्तमिव भ्रामन्तम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa madhyaṅgatamaṃśumantaṃ |
jyotsnāvitānam mahadudvamantam |
dadarśa dhīmān divi bhānumantam |
gośhṭhe vṛśhaṃ mattamiva bhrāmantam
verses.translation: Thereafter that intellectual Hanuma saw the moon in the sky shining with rays, obtaining the middle portion of sky. Spreading a great quantity of moon shine, moon looked like a bull in heat among cows.

glosses.meaning: who obtaining the middle of sky
a great quantity of moon shine

verses.devanagari:
लोकस्य पापानि विनाशयन्तम् |
महोदधिं चापि समेधयन्तम् |
भूतानि सर्वाणि विराजयन्तम् |
ददर्श शीतांशुमथाभियान्तम्
verses.iast:
lokasya pāpāni vināśayantam |
mahodadhiṃ cāpi samedhayantam |
bhūtāni sarvāṇi virājayantam |
dadarśa śītāṃśumathābhiyāntam
verses.translation: After that Hanuma saw the moon coming up destroying the sins of the world, causing the great ocean to grow and causing all living beings to shine.

glosses.meaning: and also causing the growth of

verses.devanagari:
या भाति लक्ष्मीर्भुवि मन्दरस्था |
तथा प्रदोषेषु च सागरस्था |
तथैव तोयेषु च पुष्करस्था |
रराज सा चारुनिशाकरस्था
verses.iast:
yā bhāti lakśmīrbhuvi mandarasthā |
tathā pradośheśhu ca sāgarasthā |
tathaiva toyeśhu ca puśhkarasthā |
rarāja sā cāruniśākarasthā
verses.translation: What ever splendour shines over Mount Mandara on earth, on the ocean during evenings, over the lotuses in the waters, the same splendour shone on the beautiful moon.

verses.devanagari:
हंसो यथा राजतपञ्जरसथः |
सिम्हो यथा मन्दरकन्दरस्थः |
वीरो यथा गर्वितकुञ्जरस्थ |
श्चन्द्रो विबभ्राज तथामभरस्थः
verses.iast:
haṃso yathā rājatapaJṇjarasathaḥ |
simho yathā mandarakandarasthaḥ |
vīro yathā garvitakuJṇjarastha |
ścandro vibabhrāja tathāmabharasthaḥ
verses.translation: Like a swan in a silver cage, like a lion in the cave of Mount Mandara, like a warrior on a proud elephant, in the same way the moon shone in the sky.

glosses.meaning: in a cave of Mount Mandara

verses.devanagari:
स्थितह् ककुद्मानिव तीक्ष्णशृङ्गो |
महाचलः श्वेत इवोच्चशृङ्गः |
हस्तीव जाम्बूनदबद्धश्^इङ्गो |
रराज चन्द्रह् परिपूर्णशृङ्गः
verses.iast:
sthitah kakudmāniva tīkśṇaśṛṇ^go |
mahācalaḥ śveta ivoccaśṛṇ^gaḥ |
hastīva jāmbūnadabaddhaś^iṇ^go |
rarāja candrah paripūrṇaśṛṇ^gaḥ
verses.translation: The full moon with its horn like spot shone like a sharp horned standing ox with a high hump, like a great white mountain with tall summits, like an elephant with golden tusks.

glosses.meaning: standing tiikshnasR^igaH = with a high hump

verses.devanagari:
विनष्टशीताम्बुतुषारपङ्को |
महाग्रहग्राहविनष्टपङ्कः |
प्रकाशलक्ष्म्याश्रयनिर्मलाङ्को |
रराज चन्द्रो भगवान् शशाङ्कः
verses.iast:
vinaśhṭaśītāmbutuśhārapaṇ^ko |
mahāgrahagrāhavinaśhṭapaṇ^kaḥ |
prakāśalakśmyāśrayanirmalāṇ^ko |
rarāja candro bhagavān śaśāṇ^kaḥ
verses.translation: The Divine moon who lost the stain of cold water and frost, with lost stain due to eclipse by the great planet sun, one who has a calm spot which is an abode of brilliant splendour, with a symbol of hare, shone brilliantly.

glosses.meaning: who lost cold water and frost
with lost stain due to the eclipse of the sun
one who has a calm spot which is an abode of brilliant splendour

verses.devanagari:
शीलातलम् प्राप्य यथा मृगेन्द्रो |
महारणम् प्राप्य यथा गजेन्द्रह् |
राज्यम् समासाद्य यथा नरेन्द्र |
स्तथाप्रकाशो विरराज चन्द्रः
verses.iast:
śīlātalam prāpya yathā mṛgendro |
mahāraṇam prāpya yathā gajendrah |
rājyam samāsādya yathā narendra |
stathāprakāśo virarāja candraḥ
verses.translation: In whatever way a lion obtaining a level surfaced rock (shines), in whatever way best elephant obtaining a great battle(shines), in whatever way a king obtaining kingdom(shines), in the same way the clear moon shone.

verses.devanagari:
प्रकाशचन्द्रोदयनष्टदोषः |
प्रवृत्तरक्षः पिशिताशदोषः |
रामाभिरामेरितचित्तदोषः |
स्वर्गप्रकाशो भगवान् प्रदोषः
verses.iast:
prakāśacandrodayanaśhṭadośhaḥ |
pravṛttarakśaḥ piśitāśadośhaḥ |
rāmābhirāmeritacittadośhaḥ |
svargaprakāśo bhagavān pradośhaḥ
verses.translation: The Divine evening with lost stain due to rise of shining moon, with the stain due to meal of flesh eating rakshasas, and in which the bitterness of mind of young women and their lovers is wiped away, became with a heavenly glow.

glosses.meaning: with lost stain due to rise of shining moon
with the stain due to meal of flesh eating rakshasas
and in which the bitterness of mind of young women and their lover is wiped away

verses.devanagari:
तन्त्रीस्वनाह् कर्णसुखाः प्रवृत्ताः |
स्वपन्ति नार्यः पतिभिः सुवृत्ताः |
नक्तंचराश्चापि तथा प्रवृत्ता |
विहर्तुमत्यद्भुतरौद्रवृत्ताः
verses.iast:
tantrīsvanāh karṇasukhāḥ pravṛttāḥ |
svapanti nāryaḥ patibhiḥ suvṛttāḥ |
naktaṃcarāścāpi tathā pravṛttā |
vihartumatyadbhutaraudravṛttāḥ
verses.translation: Musical notes from stringed instruments which were comforting to ears started. Women with good character were sleeping with husbands and also rakshasas with extremely strange character started to roam.

verses.devanagari:
मत्तप्रमत्तानि समाकुलानि |
तथाश्वभद्रासनसम्कुलानि |
वीरः श्रिया चापि समाकुलानि |
ददर्श धीमान् स कपिः कुलानि
verses.iast:
mattapramattāni samākulāni |
tathāśvabhadrāsanasamkulāni |
vīraḥ śriyā cāpi samākulāni |
dadarśa dhīmān sa kapiḥ kulāni
verses.translation: That Hanuma the courageous one, the intellectual one, saw houses with people in heat, houses filled with people, full chariots, horses, elephants and best furniture and also full of wealth.

verses.devanagari:
परस्परं चाधिकमाक्षिपन्ति |
भुआंश्च पीनानधिनिक्षिपन्ति |
मत्तप्रलापानधिकम् क्षिपन्ति |
मत्तानि चान्योन्यमधिक्षिपन्ति
verses.iast:
parasparaṃ cādhikamākśipanti |
bhuāṃśca pīnānadhinikśipanti |
mattapralāpānadhikam kśipanti |
mattāni cānyonyamadhikśipanti
verses.translation: Hanuma saw rakshasas railing a lot at one another moving their heavy shoulders, throwing wild and incoherent words a lot, insulting one another being intoxicated.

glosses.meaning: wild and incoherent words a lot

verses.devanagari:
रक्षांसि वक्षांसि च विक्षिपन्ति |
गात्राणि कान्तासु च विक्षिपन्ति |
रूपाअणि चित्राणि च विक्षिपन्ति |
दृढानि चापानि च विक्षिपन्ति
verses.iast:
rakśāṃsi vakśāṃsi ca vikśipanti |
gātrāṇi kāntāsu ca vikśipanti |
rūpāaṇi citrāṇi ca vikśipanti |
dṛḍhāni cāpāni ca vikśipanti
verses.translation: (Hanuma saw) rakshasas who smote breast, those who threw limbs on women, those who were spreading their strange forms sporting their strong bows.

verses.devanagari:
ददर्श कान्ताश्च समालभन्त्य |
स्तथा परास्तत्र पुनः स्वपन्त्यः |
सुरूपवक्त्राश्च तथा हसन्त्यः |
क्रुद्धाः पराश्चपि विनिःश्वसन्त्यः
verses.iast:
dadarśa kāntāśca samālabhantya |
stathā parāstatra punaḥ svapantyaḥ |
surūpavaktrāśca tathā hasantyaḥ |
kruddhāḥ parāścapi viniḥśvasantyaḥ
verses.translation: Hanuma saw some women applying sandal paste on their bodies and also some other women sleeping there, in the same way some women with good appearance were smiling, and some other women were sighing in anger.

glosses.meaning: applying sandal paste on their bodies

verses.devanagari:
महागजैश्चापि तथा नदद्भिः |
सुपूजितैश्चापि तथा सुसद्भिः |
रराज वीरैश्च विनिःश्वसद्भि |
र्ह्रदो भुजङ्गैरिव निःश्वसद्भिः
verses.iast:
mahāgajaiścāpi tathā nadadbhiḥ |
supūjitaiścāpi tathā susadbhiḥ |
rarāja vīraiśca viniḥśvasadbhi |
rhrado bhujaṇ^gairiva niḥśvasadbhiḥ
verses.translation: Hanuma saw (the city of Lanka that) shone with great elephants making sound and also with gentlemen well respected, shone with warriors in a wresting bout, with long sighs, like serpents in a lake hissing.

verses.devanagari:
बुद्धिप्रधानान् रुचिराभिधानान् |
संश्रद्दधानान् जगतः प्रधानान् |
नानाविधानान् रुचिराभिधानान् |
ददर्श तस्याम् पुरि यातुधानान्
verses.iast:
buddhipradhānān rucirābhidhānān |
saṃśraddadhānān jagataḥ pradhānān |
nānāvidhānān rucirābhidhānān |
dadarśa tasyām puri yātudhānān
verses.translation: Hanuma saw Yatudhanaas who were intellectuals, who were good talkers, who had good devotion, important people to the world, who had various ways, and people who had beautiful names in that city.

verses.devanagari:
ननन्द दृष्ट्वा स च तान् सुरूपा |
न्नानागुणानात्मगुणानुरूपान् |
विद्योतमानान्स तदानुरूपान् |
ददर्श कांश्चिच्च पुनर्विरूपान्
verses.iast:
nananda dṛśhṭvā sa ca tān surūpā |
nnānāguṇānātmaguṇānurūpān |
vidyotamānānsa tadānurūpān |
dadarśa kāṃścicca punarvirūpān
verses.translation: That Hanuma seeing people with good appearance, who had various good virtues, those who were according to their character, those who were radiant, all those - became happy. Then that Hanuma saw those who had horrific appearance, those who were according to their appearance - some of those too.

glosses.meaning: those who were according to their character
those who were according to their appearance

verses.devanagari:
ततो वरार्हः सुविशुद्धभावा |
स्तेषाम् स्त्रियस्तत्र महानुभावाह् |
प्रियेषु पानेषु च सक्तभावा |
ददर्श ताराइव सुप्रभावाः
verses.iast:
tato varārhaḥ suviśuddhabhāvā |
steśhām striyastatra mahānubhāvāh |
priyeśhu pāneśhu ca saktabhāvā |
dadarśa tārāiva suprabhāvāḥ
verses.translation: Hanuma saw thereafter there, their women - those who were eligible for distinction, those who were of great skill with an interested heart in lovers and in drinks and those who were like stars with good effect.

glosses.meaning: those who were eligible for distinction
those who were of great skill

verses.devanagari:
श्रिया ज्वलन्तीस्त्रपयोगूढा |
निशीथकाले रमणोपगूढाः |
ददर्श काश्चित्प्रमदोपगूढा |
यथा विहङ्गाः कुसुमोपगूढाः
verses.iast:
śriyā jvalantīstrapayogūḍhā |
niśīthakāle ramaṇopagūḍhāḥ |
dadarśa kāścitpramadopagūḍhā |
yathā vihaṇ^gāḥ kusumopagūḍhāḥ
verses.translation: Hanuma saw some women who were brilliant with radiance, adorned a lot with bashfulness, those who were hugged by lovers in the middle of night, those who were hugged with great pleasure, those who were hugged by flowers like birds.

glosses.meaning: those who were hugged by lovers
those who were hugged with great pleasure
those who were hugged by flowers

verses.devanagari:
अन्याः पुनर्हर्म्यतलोपविष्टा |
स्तत्र प्रियाङ्केषु सुखोपविष्टाः |
भर्तुः प्रिया धर्मपरा निविष्टा |
ददर्श धीमान् मदनाभिविष्टाः
verses.iast:
anyāḥ punarharmyatalopaviśhṭā |
statra priyāṇ^keśhu sukhopaviśhṭāḥ |
bhartuḥ priyā dharmaparā niviśhṭā |
dadarśa dhīmān madanābhiviśhṭāḥ
verses.translation: The intellectual Hanuma saw some other women there comfortably sitting on the laps of their lovers, at the top of their buildings, dear to their husbands and (some other women) interested in virtuous deeds, and some possessed by the lord of love.

glosses.meaning: comfortably sitting on the laps of the lovers
at the top of their buildings
dear to their husbands(some other women)
(some other women) possessed by the lord of love.

verses.devanagari:
अप्रावृताः काञ्चनराजिवर्णाः |
काश्चित्परार्थ्यास्तपनीयवर्णाः |
पुनश्च काश्चिच्छशलक्ष्मवर्णाः |
कान्तप्रहीणारुचिराङ्गवर्णाः
verses.iast:
aprāvṛtāḥ kāJṇcanarājivarṇāḥ |
kāścitparārthyāstapanīyavarṇāḥ |
punaśca kāścicchaśalakśmavarṇāḥ |
kāntaprahīṇārucirāṇ^gavarṇāḥ
verses.translation: Hanuma saw women with golden complexion lacking clothes, women with a complexion of refined gold suitable for mating and some other women also with the colour of moon and some other women with beautiful bodies lacking a lover.

glosses.meaning: women with a complexion of refined gold

verses.devanagari:
ततह् प्रियान् प्राप्य मनोभिरामान् |
सुप्रीतियुक्ताः सुमनोभिरामाः |
गृहेषु हृष्टाः परमाभिरामाः |
हरिप्रवीरः स ददर्श रामाः
verses.iast:
tatah priyān prāpya manobhirāmān |
suprītiyuktāḥ sumanobhirāmāḥ |
gṛheśhu hṛśhṭāḥ paramābhirāmāḥ |
haripravīraḥ sa dadarśa rāmāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter that Vanara warrior saw those with great happiness, those who obtained lovers who entertained, those who attracted like flowers, those with great beauty and women in their houses filled with happiness.

verses.devanagari:
चन्द्रप्रकाशाश्च हि वक्त्रमाला |
वक्राक्षिपक्ष्माश्च सुनेत्रमालाः |
विभूषाणानाम् च ददर्श मालाः |
शतह्रदानामिव चारुमालाः
verses.iast:
candraprakāśāśca hi vaktramālā |
vakrākśipakśmāśca sunetramālāḥ |
vibhūśhāṇānām ca dadarśa mālāḥ |
śatahradānāmiva cārumālāḥ
verses.translation: Hanuma saw rows of faces shining like the moon, beautiful rows of eyes with curved eyebrows and rows of ornaments like beautiful rows of lighting.

verses.devanagari:
न त्वेव सीताम् परमाभिजाताम् |
पथि स्थिते राजकुले प्रजाताम् |
लताम् प्रपुल्लामिव साधु जाताम् |
ददर्श तन्वीम् मनसाभिजाताम्
verses.iast:
na tveva sītām paramābhijātām |
pathi sthite rājakule prajātām |
latām prapullāmiva sādhu jātām |
dadarśa tanvīm manasābhijātām
verses.translation: Hanuma did not see Seetha, one with great beauty born in a royal family following a virtuous path, well brought up, like a creeper in full blossom, one who was thin, and one who was born from the mind (of creator).

verses.devanagari:
सनातने वर्त्मानि सम्निविष्टाम् |
रामेक्षणां तां मदनाभिविष्टाम् |
भर्तुर्मनः श्रीमदनुप्रविष्टाम् |
स्त्रीभ्यो वराभ्यश्च सदा विशिष्टाम्
verses.iast:
sanātane vartmāni samniviśhṭām |
rāmekśaṇāṃ tāṃ madanābhiviśhṭām |
bharturmanaḥ śrīmadanupraviśhṭām |
strībhyo varābhyaśca sadā viśiśhṭām
verses.translation: Hanuma did not see that Seetha who stood in the path of ancient righteousness with Her sight on Sri Rama, who was possessed by the love for Sri Rama, who entered the glorious mind of husband and always the best among women who were the best.

glosses.meaning: in the path of ancient righteousness
with Her sight on Sri Rama
who was possessed by the love for Sri Rama

verses.devanagari:
उष्णार्दिताम् सानुसृतास्रकण्ठीम् |
पुरा वरार्होत्तमनिष्ककण्ठीम् |
सुजातपक्ष्मामभिरक्तकण्ठीम् |
वनेऽप्रनृत्तामिव नीलकण्ठीम्
verses.iast:
uśhṇārditām sānusṛtāsrakaṇṭhīm |
purā varārhottamaniśhkakaṇṭhīm |
sujātapakśmāmabhiraktakaṇṭhīm |
vane'pranṛttāmiva nīlakaṇṭhīm
verses.translation: Hanuma did not see Seetha, tortured by separation from Sri Rama, with unabounding tears in her throat, in earlier times who had invaluable and best jewellery on her neck, born with beautiful eyebrows, with a sweet voice, like a she- hen who did not dance in a forest because of Her current sorrow.

glosses.meaning: tourched by separation from Sri Rama
with unabounding tears in her throat
who had invaluable and best jewellery on her neck

verses.devanagari:
अव्यक्तरेखामिव चन्द्ररेखां |
पांसुप्रदिग्धामिव हेमरेखाम् |
क्षतप्ररूढामिव बाणरेखां |
वायुप्रभिन्नामिव मेघरेक्षाम्
verses.iast:
avyaktarekhāmiva candrarekhāṃ |
pāṃsupradigdhāmiva hemarekhām |
kśataprarūḍhāmiva bāṇarekhāṃ |
vāyuprabhinnāmiva megharekśām
verses.translation: Hanuma did not see Seetha who was like a crescent with a blurred outline, like a streek of gold coated by dust, like an arrow in an injury, like a series of clouds scattered by wind.

verses.devanagari:
सीतामपश्यन् मनुजेश्वरस्य |
रामस्य पत्नीम् वदताम् वरस्य |
बभूव दुःखाभिहतश्चिरस्य |
प्लवङ्गमो मन्द इवाचिरस्य
verses.iast:
sītāmapaśyan manujeśvarasya |
rāmasya patnīm vadatām varasya |
babhūva duḥkhābhihataścirasya |
plavaṇ^gamo manda ivācirasya
verses.translation: Hanuma became a numb minded one for sometime, stricken with grief not seeing for a moment Seetha, wife of Sri Rama the best among those who talk, and the lord of all humans.
